context: Hi, can I help you pick a movie trailer?
Yes I'd like a recommendation please
awesome. Can you tell me what types of movies you like?
Im a big fan of sci-fi,action,adventure, and thrillers
i love action/adventure and thrillers too! do you have any favorite actors or actresses?
The actor/actress is not really important to me as long as the plot is good and there is plenty of action. Visual effects are a big plus.
ok cool - 1 more question...would you prefer a new release or something that's been out for a while?
Definitely something new and fresh
ok, here's my favorite favorite movie that I've seen recently - Bad Boys 3
That sounds good to me. I accept your recommendation. Seems like a great action flick.
it is great, not only a lot of action but really funny too!
Is it as funny as the previous Bad Boys films? Or funnier? Martin Lawrence cracks me up everytime.
In my opinion, it's the second funniest after the original movie.
Awesome! Can you recommend something else? Im a big fan of comic-book movies.
I'm not as big a fan of comic book movies, but i've heard bloodshot is supposed to be really good.
Is that the one with Vin Diesel?
yup, that's the one
Ok I'll take your word for it. I accept your recommendation.
ok cool...do you think you'd prefer bad boys or bloodshot?
Probably Bad Boys because Im familiar with the previous films so I know what to expect. Bloodshot might just be a nice surprise though.

context.content: I want to watch a movie that I can watch with my family. I am not sure what to choose.

Hey there! I understand the challenge of picking a movie for the whole family. Since I enjoy thrillers, I was thinking maybe we could look for something thrilling yet family-friendly? [END]
 To: Seeker, are you interested in a thriller that also has elements of family entertainment? I have a few options in mind. Would you like me to share them?
